visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a striped polo shirt and glasses, wearing a headset, enters a modern office/studio through a glass door, holding a white mug. He looks annoyed and gestures toward the room. (2) He walks into the main office area, which features industrial-style lighting, desks with computer monitors, and shelves stocked with snacks. Two women and another man are seated at a desk. (3) The man stands before a whiteboard in a well-lit room with large windows showing a city skyline. He writes "The DoDo Men" on the board with a blue marker, underlining "Men" and pointing at it while looking intensely at the camera. (4) He notices a female student eating fried chicken and reacts with exaggerated, wide-eyed shock. The camera uses speed ramps and close-ups to emphasize his reaction. (5) He presents a green and white box of "Future Salad" drink mix, holding it up clearly to the frame. (6) A montage shows him pouring green powder from a sachet into a water bottle, shaking it vigorously, and drinking the green liquid with a satisfied expression. (7) He returns to the students, handing the salad mix box to the girl who was eating chicken, while gesturing with an open palm.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Comedic shouting with high vocal arousal and high intensity starts immediately. A sharp whoosh SFX triggers a transition. Upbeat, fast-tempo electronic BGM plays in the background. (2) A loud cartoon 'ding' sound effect punctuates a funny facial expression. The speaker continues with a rapid, exaggerated delivery style and rising intonation. (3) A sharp impact SFX sounds as the speaker emphasizes a point. The BGM remains energetic. Background laughter from other voices is briefly audible under the main track. (4) A metallic click and a muffled thud are heard as the speaker prepares to show an object. The BGM tempo remains steady. (5) Sound of a plastic packet being torn open, followed by a clear liquid pouring sound into a container. The speaker's voice shifts to a friendly, informative narrative tone. (6) Rapid, rhythmic liquid shaking sounds inside a plastic bottle create a distinct acoustic texture for several seconds, ending with a final percussive 'pop' sound. (7) A clear swallowing sound is followed by a satisfied 'Ah' vocalization. The speaker's pitch remains high and energetic as he continues his endorsement. (8) Background crunching noises from food consumption are heard, followed by a bright comedic jingle that closes the main narrative sequence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Comedic Conflict -> Product Solution -> Demonstration -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a comedic 'angry teacher' skit to promote Future Salad drink mix. It addresses the common health problem of eating out frequently without enough vegetables, positioning the product as a convenient and tasty solution for busy students or workers.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct presentation of the product, detailed demonstration of preparation, and verbal listing of its health benefits.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-production value social media ad utilizing a popular YouTube persona and meme-style editing to drive product engagement.
